description: Dense Lanczos-Krylov reference propagation for Hermitian Hamiltonians. The implementation applies a Krylov approximation to each computational-basis state and assembles the resulting small-system propagator.
applicable_hamiltonians: Small Hermitian Hamiltonians requiring a dense reference propagator
Legacy lists of Hermitian dense matrix terms
limitations: This is a dense reference implementation, not a sparse or distributed Krylov solver
The propagator is assembled from independent state actions; users must assess error and unitarity for the chosen Krylov dimension
No circuit, gate-count, or hardware-resource output is available

krylov_dim.description: Maximum Lanczos subspace dimension per propagated basis state. Values larger than the Hilbert-space dimension are capped.

execution.returns: EvolutionResult containing an approximate dense unitary and Krylov configuration provenance.

complexity.gate_count: Not applicable: this dense reference does not synthesize a circuit
complexity.error_scaling: For a fixed propagated state, accuracy improves as the Lanczos subspace captures more of the spectral action; convergence depends on the Hamiltonian spectrum, evolution time, and Krylov dimension.

references.title: Krylov-subspace approximation methods for quantum time evolution
